sources.snippet: Iris-3B — a fully open 3B-parameter pixel-space text-to-image model, latent-to-pixel conversion of FLUX.2 klein, and pixel vs latent backbones for depth and restoration.

sources.title: [2610.09450] Iris-3B: Going Beyond the Latent with Pixel-Space ...
sources.snippet: We pretrain Iris-3B, a 3B-parameter pixel-space text-to-image transformer, from scratch through a 256 → 512 → 1024 curriculum, after first ablating the prediction target and representation alignment at 2562 to decide what to scale. We also convert a pretrained latent model, FLUX.2 Klein base 4B, to pixel space.

sources.title: IBM-NASA Surya open source AI model forecasts solar flares
sources.snippet: Surya is an open source model from IBM and NASA, designed to predict solar flares and space weather effects on Earth.
